test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct related to respiration?

(i) Pyruvate is converted into ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast during fermentation.

(ii) The break-down of pyruvate using oxygen takes place in chloroplast.

(iii) In muscle cells, pyruvate is converted into lactic acid.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (i) and (iii)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pyruvate is converted into ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast during fermentation:** This anaerobic process is known as alcoholic fermentation and occurs in yeast cells.
 
• **In muscle cells, pyruvate is converted into lactic acid:** This process is known as lactic acid fermentation and occurs under anaerobic conditions in muscle cells.
 
• During anaerobic respiration, the complete breakdown of glucose does not occur, which leads to the formation of by-products such as ethanol, carbon dioxide, and lactic acid.
 
• These processes allow cells to generate energy (ATP) without the presence of oxygen, although less efficiently than aerobic respiration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chloroplast:** The organelle in plant cells where photosynthesis occurs. It is not involved in the breakdown of pyruvate using oxygen.
 
• **Aerobic Respiration:** A metabolic process in which pyruvate is fully broken down to carbon dioxide and water in the presence of oxygen, primarily occurring in the mitochondria.
 
• **Fermentation:** A metabolic process that converts sugar to acids, gases, or alcohol in the absence of oxygen. It includes alcoholic fermentation in yeast and lactic acid fermentation in muscle cells.
 
• **ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate):** The energy currency of the cell, produced during both aerobic and anaerobic respiration.
 
• **Mitochondria:** The powerhouse of the cell where aerobic respiration and energy (ATP) production take place.
